scripts.start: docker compose up -d; pnpm run playwright:test
scripts.test: docker compose build && docker compose up -d; docker compose run --build --rm playwright npx playwright test; docker compose down
scripts.test:update: docker compose build && docker compose up -d && pnpm run playwright:test --update-snapshots; docker compose down
scripts.test:ui: docker compose build && docker compose up -d && pnpm run playwright:test --ui; docker compose down
scripts.test:headed: docker compose up -d && pnpm run playwright:test --headed; docker compose down
